d:
Taken from "Chapter III: We Return to Light" by Anoushka Shankar.
On March 14, the acclaimed sitar player, producer and composer, shares the third and final installment of her trilogy of mini-albums: "We Return to Light" will be released by LEITER on vinyl and via all digital platforms. You can already listen to the first two offerings, "Hiraeth" and "We Burn So Brightly", out now.
Written by Anoushka Shankar, Alam Khan, Sarathy Korwar
Produced by Sarathy Korwar
Sitar: Anoushka Shankar
Sarod: Alam Khan
Drums, Percussion, Synthesisers: Sarathy Korwar
Morsing: Pirashanna Thevarajah
